rules.sourcePrinciple: Normalize only approved Unit A textbook and seminar resources from checksum-verified archives through an idempotent transactional command that never rewrites canonical lesson HTML.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Reuse the transaction, checksum, PDF-normalization, and asset-ownership pattern only after each unit has an explicit approved resource inventory and page map.
rules.recovery: Reject drift; preserve originals; stage a new inventory rather than overwrite accepted sources.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Provide one local textbook Library and connect every lesson and review summary action to an exact chapter, printed page, physical PDF page, and recommended question set.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Build a unit-specific printed-to-physical page map and crosswalk; never infer page ranges from Unit A.
rules.recovery: Reconcile printed folios with PDF pages; do not substitute PDF arithmetic for inspection.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Hide textbook answers until the learner confirms an attempt, persist that attempt independently, and allow answers to be hidden without changing scoring, completion, or other saved work.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Reuse the interaction rule with unit-namespaced stable IDs and unit-specific corrected answer content.
rules.recovery: Reconcile printed folios with PDF pages; do not substitute PDF arithmetic for inspection.

rules.sourcePrinciple: After a learner checks any of the 51 Guided Practice questions or 24 Final Practice questions, place one exact local textbook-page action inside the revealed feedback. Distinguish direct support from the closest available support when the local course corrects or extends the older textbook, leave Module Checks unchanged, and use Final Practice as the learner-facing name without changing its 24-question scoring or completion behavior.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Create a question-level crosswalk from each unit's own textbook and practice bank. Never reuse Unit A pages, and label closest support honestly when newer course content exceeds the source textbook.
rules.recovery: Reconcile printed folios with PDF pages; do not substitute PDF arithmetic for inspection.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Group lessons by their textbook chapter, place the required final integration lesson in a final Integration and Mastery subgroup under Lessons, and keep the separate Review navigation group optional.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Use each unit's real textbook structure and preserve its required final lesson; do not copy Unit A chapter names or route count.
rules.recovery: Repair the exact missing mechanism or prerequisite; never raise reading difficulty to add depth.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Rebuild chapter review, seminar, and textbook unit review as student-facing web content with current terminology, corrected source ambiguities, saved reasoning, and explanatory answer reveals.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Re-author from each unit's learner-visible review sources, current curriculum, and correction ledger; do not transplant Unit A science content.
rules.recovery: Reconcile printed folios with PDF pages; do not substitute PDF arithmetic for inspection.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Exclude secure chapter quizzes, quiz keys, Unit tests, test answers, broken LMS launchers, and teacher-only assessment material from learner delivery.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Apply only after a unit-specific visibility and disposition audit; secure assessment remains native Brightspace content.
rules.recovery: Reject drift; preserve originals; stage a new inventory rather than overwrite accepted sources.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Keep one unit-level safety statement, remove oversized generic lesson safety cards, and place only essential cautions beside the activity they govern.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Retain only hazards and limitations relevant to each unit's actual investigation or health context.
rules.recovery: Repair the exact missing mechanism or prerequisite; never raise reading difficulty to add depth.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Keep each retrieval prompt and its label, textarea, and status in a stable two-column desktop layout that stacks in reading order on mobile without changing saved-response IDs.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Reuse the responsive structure while preserving each unit's existing response IDs, labels, autosave hooks, and content sequence.
rules.recovery: Repair the exact missing mechanism or prerequisite; never raise reading difficulty to add depth.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Inventory checksum-verified source decks transactionally, account for every slide, embedded asset, and link, and keep generated media reports separate from canonical learner HTML.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Reuse the transaction and inventory pattern only with unit-specific source hashes, counts, rights review, correction ledger, and explicit learner destinations.
rules.recovery: Reject drift; preserve originals; stage a new inventory rather than overwrite accepted sources.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Regenerate approved source-image derivatives from exact checksum-verified PDF pages or PowerPoint media relationships through an idempotent transaction that owns only its asset directory and report, never canonical lesson HTML.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Reuse the transaction pattern only after each unit has its own explicit source-image selection, crop or relationship locator, checksum, rights decision, accessibility copy, and release blocker policy.
rules.recovery: Return to the exact prompt/candidate; narrowly correct errors and obtain a new teacher decision. Keep replaced assets in authoring history.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Show one strongest visual for each teaching purpose: replace an exact redundant static figure with its stronger contract-selected source plate, retain distinct semantic figures and interactions, and keep a source image supplemental only when it contributes different evidence or anatomy. Require explicit accuracy, accessibility, provenance, and release treatment; never use a full slide or screenshot as instruction.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Make a figure-by-figure decision from each unit's own deck inventory; Unit A treatment choices do not authorize reuse of another unit's imagery.
rules.recovery: Return to the exact prompt/candidate; narrowly correct errors and obtain a new teacher decision. Keep replaced assets in authoring history.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Place reviewed optional videos beside exact lesson concepts and in one filterable Video Library, automatically show the native privacy-enhanced preview only when its lesson or selected library entry is visible, never autoplay, leave hidden entries unloaded, and retain a complete local concept summary when video access fails.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Review each unit's videos for accuracy, captions, availability, embedding, duplication, and learner value before exposing them; every accepted video needs a local fallback and exact lesson mapping.
checks: no autoplay or custom play button
rules.recovery: Use the reviewed local path when a provider fails; never silently substitute an unreviewed clip.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Generate and inspect exact-build route and component contact sheets across desktop, tablet, and mobile before proposing a pilot rule for broader use.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Create a fresh exact-build audit and human review record for each unit; Unit A screenshots and approval cannot satisfy another unit's gate.
checks: full-build teacher acceptance distinct from deployment
rules.recovery: Invalidate only evidence affected by drift, rerun on the new hash, and keep older evidence attached to its original build.

rules.recovery: Return to the exact prompt/candidate; narrowly correct errors and obtain a new teacher decision. Keep replaced assets in authoring history.

rules.sourcePrinciple: When dedicated chapter and textbook-unit review routes already provide the assigned pages, questions, and answer reveals, omit the duplicate textbook-review band from the required final integration lesson. rules.sourceAdaptation: Apply only where a target unit has complete dedicated review routes. Keep its required final integration lesson distinct from optional review resources, and preserve all stable learner-state and completion identifiers.
rules.recovery: Reconcile printed folios with PDF pages; do not substitute PDF arithmetic for inspection.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Number learner-facing Guided Practice, Module Check, and Final Practice questions from 1 within each list while preserving the stable internal practice IDs, response names, persistence keys, answer logic, scoring, and completion rules.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Render the visible ordinal as the array position plus one. Do not renumber stable IDs, form names, persistence keys, analytics keys, or answer references when correcting learner-facing labels.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Present lesson exit slips, optional learner process notes, and saved portfolio artifacts together in one learner-facing Process Collection. Read exit slips directly from their existing stable response IDs, show draft or completed status, link back to the exact exit check, and never duplicate or transfer ownership of the saved response.
rules.sourceAdaptation: Create a unit-specific collection view that reads the target unit's existing exit-response and completion identifiers. Preserve state ownership, response limits, artifact contracts, and completion rules; do not copy Unit A IDs, lesson titles, or route inventory.
rules.recovery: Keep last valid state; expose failed saving and offer copy. Never count a selection as a saved explanation.

rules.sourcePrinciple: Teach a deliberately selected layer of high-value scientific concept families separately from the complete glossary. For each family, connect learner-friendly meaning, morphology or word history, biological mechanism, examples, common confusions, exact lesson and textbook locations, retrieval, and a science-adapted Frayer model; collect only complete learner-selected Frayer evidence in Process Collection without changing required course completion.
rules.sourceAdaptation: For each target unit, first audit its curriculum outcomes, lessons, textbook, practice, recurring mechanisms, common misconceptions, and useful morphology. Select a new unit-specific core-family inventory, author fresh Frayer models and links, budget persistence against that unit's own state contract, implement through scripts/lib/biology30-course/v1 rather than copied Unit A HTML, and require a representative-slice review before full rollout. Unit A terms, counts, response IDs, mappings, and acceptance do not transfer.
